title: Ground Beef Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Brown ground beef with diced onion in a skillet over medium-high heat. Drain excess fat.
Spread the browned beef and onion mixture evenly across the bottom of a greased casserole dish.
Layer the sliced cooked potatoes on top of the meat.
Lay the cheese slices over the potatoes.
Pour the cream of mushroom soup evenly over the entire mixture.
Separate the biscuits and arrange them on top of the casserole.
Bake for 20–25 minutes, or until the biscuits are golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbling.

title: Creamy Beef And Macaroni Whip-Up
directions: Brown ground beef in a large pan over medium-high heat, breaking it apart as it cooks. Drain excess fat.
Meanwhile, cook macaroni noodles in a pot of salted boiling water according to package directions. Drain.
Add the drained noodles and spaghetti sauce to the pan with the ground beef. Stir to combine.
Add mayonnaise and stir until fully incorporated.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese on top.
Serve hot.

title: Beef Hash

ingredients.name: beef gravy
ingredients.alternative: beef broth thickened with 1 tsp cornstarch

directions: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add diced beef, potatoes, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Stir to combine.
Pour in the beef gravy and stir well.
Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until everything is heated through.
Increase heat to medium-high and press the mixture flat. Allow it to brown on the bottom, about 5 minutes.
Stir and press flat again, letting it brown once more for another 4–5 minutes.
Serve hot.

title: Beef Stew

ingredients.name: carrots
ingredients.measurement: 3 medium, peeled and cut into chunks

directions: Heat a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat with a splash of oil.
Add stew meat and brown on all sides, about 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Add onions, potatoes, and carrots to the pot.
Pour in about 1 quart of water, enough to cover the ingredients.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low.
Cover and simmer for 1 to 1.5 hours, or until vegetables are tender and meat is cooked through.
Adjust seasoning enough. Serve with green salad and cornbread.

title: Easy Beef And Noodles
directions: In a skillet over medium-high heat, heat vegetable oil.
Add sliced steak, onion, and mushrooms. Sauté for 6–7 minutes, or until meat is no longer pink.
Set the seasoning packets from the ramen noodles aside.
In a separate saucepan, bring 4 cups of water to a boil. Add noodles and cook until tender, about 3 minutes. Drain.
Add the drained noodles, both seasoning packets, and 1/4 cup water to the skillet with the beef mixture.
Stir well and heat through for 1–2 minutes.
Serve hot.

title: Beef Gravy
directions: Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat.
If using onion, add it and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Whisk in the flour until smooth and the mixture begins to bubble, about 1 minute.
Dissolve bouillon granules in 1 1/2 cups hot water.
Gradually pour the bouillon mixture into the saucepan, whisking constantly to prevent lumps.
Continue to cook and whisk over medium heat until the gravy thickens, about 3–4 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper enough. Serve hot.

title: Easy Corned Beef Hash
directions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat, enough to cover the bottom of the pan.
Add the potatoes and cook, stirring occasionally, until they begin to soften, about 8–10 minutes.
Add the corned beef, breaking it apart and folding it gently into the potatoes.
Reduce heat to low, cover the skillet, and cook for 10–15 minutes, turning and stirring the mixture every few minutes.
Once the hash is well mixed and lightly browned, remove from heat and let it rest.
Meanwhile, bring a shallow pan of water to a gentle simmer and poach the eggs to your liking.
Divide hash onto plates, top each serving with a poached egg, and serve with toast.

title: Corned Beef Sandwich Spread
directions: Open the can of corned beef and transfer to a mixing bowl.
Break the corned beef apart thoroughly with a fork.
Add mayonnaise, mustard, and sweet relish. Stir until well combined.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed.
Spread generously onto slices of rye bread and serve.

title: Mustard Sauce For Corned Beef & Cabbage
directions: Combine beaten eggs, brown sugar, white sugar, dry mustard, and vinegar in a small saucepan.
Add margarine and place over medium heat.
Cook and stir constantly with a whisk until the sauce thickens, approximately 5 minutes.
Do not boil. Remove from heat once thickened.
Serve warm over corned beef.

title: Beef Satay
directions: Cut the beef into 3/4-inch chunks.
Combine spice paste and palm sugar in a bowl. Mix well.
Add the beef chunks and toss until evenly coated. Let marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated beef evenly onto the soaked skewers.
Lightly oil the grill grates. Preheat grill to high heat.
Lay skewers on the grill and cook, turning to brown on all sides, for 6–8 minutes total.
Serve hot or at room temperature with peanut sauce and rice.

title: Mighty Tender Beef Ribs
directions: Remove the tough membrane from the underside of the ribs near the bones. Pull it off using a paper towel for grip.
Remove any long vein found between the bones on the underside.
Toss all dry seasonings (both sugars, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper) together in a bowl. Mix well.
Pat ribs dry with paper towels, then rub the seasoning mixture generously all over the ribs.
Sprinkle salt on last, just before cooking.
Cook low and slow: grill over indirect heat at 250°F (120°C) for 3–4 hours, or bake in oven at 275°F (135°C) wrapped in foil for 3 hours, then uncovered for 30 minutes.
Ribs are done when the meat is tender and pulls away from the bone easily.

title: Baked Chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Grease a large baking pan.
Wash and thoroughly dry each piece of chicken.
Pour mayonnaise into one bowl and flour into another.
Dip each chicken piece in mayonnaise to coat, then dredge in flour.
Season each piece with salt and pepper.
Place coated chicken in the prepared baking pan.
Drizzle melted butter over the top of the chicken.
Bake for 50–60 minutes, or until the skin is golden and juices run clear when pierced.

title: Chicken Salad
directions: If using canned chicken, drain well. If using leftover chicken, shred into bite-size pieces.
Combine mayonnaise, dry mustard, garlic powder, and onion powder in a bowl. Mix until smooth.
Add chicken, celery, and green onion to the bowl.
Toss everything together until evenly coated.
Season with salt and pepper enough.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.

title: Easy Chicken And Noodles

ingredients.name: cream of chicken soup
ingredients.alternative: homemade white sauce with chicken broth

directions: Place chicken breasts in a large pot. Cover with water and add 2 tsp salt.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat. Simmer for 30–40 minutes until chicken is fully cooked.
Remove chicken from broth and let cool slightly. Reserve the broth.
Shred or cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces, discarding skin and bones if any.
Bring the reserved broth back to a boil. Add the egg noodles and cook according to package directions.
Stir in the cream of chicken soup and mix until smooth.
Return the shredded chicken to the pot. Stir well and season with remaining salt and pepper.
Simmer for 5 more minutes and serve hot.

title: Cream Of Chicken Soup
directions: Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Sauté diced onion and zucchini until softened, about 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and let cool slightly, then transfer to a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Return the blended mixture to the saucepan. Add chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Whisk in Cream of Wheat slowly to avoid lumps.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper enough. Serve hot.

title: Bev's Italian Chicken Crock Pot Style Recipe

ingredients.name: dry Italian spaghetti sauce mix
ingredients.alternative: homemade Italian seasoning mix (oregano, basil, garlic powder)

directions: Place chicken breasts in the bottom of the slow cooker.
Sprinkle the dry Italian spaghetti sauce mix evenly over the chicken.
Pour the canned diced tomatoes and tomato sauce over the top.
Cover and cook on LOW for 7–9 hours, or on HIGH for 3.5–4.5 hours.
When done, shred the chicken with two forks directly in the slow cooker and stir into the sauce.
Serve over cooked penne pasta, topped with Parmesan cheese.

title: Sesame Curry Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients in a jar with a tight-fitting lid.
Seal and shake vigorously until well combined.
Taste and adjust sweetness or spice as desired.
Use immediately as a glaze, or refrigerate until ready to use.
Brush over chicken, meat, or fish while grilling. Apply another coat when you flip.

title: Mama's Chicken Dumplings
directions: Place the whole chicken in a large pot. Cover with water and add 1 tsp salt.
Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to a steady simmer.
Cook chicken until fully cooked through, about 45–60 minutes.
While chicken simmers, make the dumplings: combine flour and cold water in a bowl and mix until a soft dough forms.
Lightly flour a surface and roll the dough out thin.
Cut the dough into small pieces or strips.
Bring the chicken broth in the pot to a rolling boil. Drop the dough pieces in one at a time.
Sprinkle in black pepper, stir gently, and cook until dumplings are done and float to the surface, about 10 minutes.
Remove chicken, shred the meat, and return it to the pot. Serve hot.

title: Honey Chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Melt butter in a small saucepan. Add honey, mustard, curry powder, and salt. Stir to combine.
Place chicken pieces in a baking dish in a single layer.
Pour the honey-butter sauce evenly over the chicken, turning pieces to coat.
Bake uncovered for 45–60 minutes, basting every 15 minutes with the sauce from the bottom of the pan.
Chicken is done when golden, caramelized, and juices run clear.

title: Deep-Fat Fried Chicken
directions: Heat vegetable oil in a deep fryer or large heavy pot to 375°F (190°C).
Combine flour, salt, and pepper in a shallow bowl.
Dredge each chicken piece in the flour mixture, shaking off any excess.
Carefully lower chicken pieces into the hot oil in batches. Do not overcrowd.
Fry for 15 minutes or until golden brown and cooked through (internal temp 165°F / 74°C).
Remove chicken and drain on paper towels.
Serve hot.

title: Grilled Ginger-Glazed Chicken
directions: Stir together Dijon mustard, brown sugar, honey, and grated ginger in a small bowl until combined.
Coat grill rack with nonstick cooking spray.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
Place chicken on the grill and brush the top side with half of the glaze.
Cover and grill for 5–7 minutes.
Flip the chicken, brush the other side with the remaining glaze.
Continue grilling, covered, for another 5–7 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through (170°F / 77°C internal temperature).
Remove from grill and let rest 3 minutes before serving.

title: Ginger Honey Glaze for Salmon or Chicken
directions: Combine water, bouillon granules, brown sugar, honey, Dijon mustard, and grated ginger in a small saucepan.
Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Continue stirring and cooking for about 5 minutes until the glaze thickens slightly.
Remove from heat and let stand until your meat is done on the grill.
Brush glaze onto one side of grilled chicken or salmon, turn, and brush the other side.
Repeat once more for a thicker glaze.
Store any remaining glaze in a tightly covered container in the refrigerator for up to 1 week.

title: Egg Foo Yong
directions: Beat eggs in a large bowl. Season with salt and pepper.
Add cooked meat, bean sprouts, and onion. Stir to combine.
Heat butter or oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Pour about 1/2 cup of the egg mixture into the skillet per patty.
Cook until the edges are set and the bottom is golden, about 2–3 minutes.
Flip and cook the other side for another 1–2 minutes.
Repeat with remaining mixture.
Serve over steamed rice with Chinese brown gravy on the side.

title: Egg Salad
directions: Hard-boil eggs: place in a pot, cover with cold water, bring to a boil, then simmer for 10 minutes. Transfer to ice water and peel.
Dice the peeled eggs into small pieces.
In a large bowl, combine diced eggs, green pepper, and onion.
Add mayonnaise and toss until evenly coated.
Season with salt and pepper enough.
Chill in the refrigerator before serving.
Serve on crisp greens, stuffed into vegetables, or as a sandwich spread.

title: Egg Noodles
directions: Beat eggs in a large bowl.
Add water and salt to the eggs and mix well.
Gradually stir in flour, one cup at a time, until a soft but not sticky dough forms.
Divide dough into 3 equal balls.
On a floured surface, roll each ball out as thin as possible.
Spread the rolled dough out on a clean surface and let dry for 30–60 minutes.
Once dry, cut the sheets into strips and then into your desired width.
Cook in boiling salted water for 5–8 minutes, or until tender. Drain and serve.

title: Egg And Cheese Oatmeal
directions: In a large bowl, crack eggs and add mayonnaise. Whisk together and set aside.
In a small pot, combine oats, water, cheese, salt, and pepper.
Cook over medium heat for about 3 minutes, stirring, until oats are cooked and cheese is fully melted.
Remove oatmeal from heat and pour into the egg bowl.
Stir everything together until well combined.
Serve immediately.

title: Italian Egg Sandwiches
directions: Toast the bread slices until golden.
Fry eggs to your preferred doneness (over easy is recommended). Season with garlic salt.
Heat pizza sauce in the microwave for 30 seconds.
Spread sauce over one side of each toasted bread slice.
Place a fried egg on top of the sauce.
Sprinkle generously with freshly grated Parmesan.
Serve immediately.

title: Potato And Ham Omelette
directions: Melt butter and olive oil together in an 8-inch frying pan over medium heat.
Add potato slices and cook for 8–10 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden and tender.
Remove potatoes from pan and drain on paper towels. Set aside.
Whisk eggs together in a bowl and season with salt and pepper.
Pour egg mixture into the same pan. Cook over medium heat for 4–5 minutes, until the omelette begins to set at the edges.
Scatter the cooked potatoes, diced red pepper, ham, cheese, and green onions over one half of the omelette.
Cover the pan with a lid and cook on low heat for another 5 minutes, until the cheese melts and the omelette is fully set.
Fold the empty half over the filling and slide onto a plate. Serve immediately.

title: Oyster Mushroom Omelette
directions: Lightly beat eggs with mustard in a bowl. Add salt and pepper enough. Set aside.
Mince the garlic.
Heat cooking oil in a wok or frying pan over medium-high heat.
Sauté garlic until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add oyster mushrooms and stir-fry for 2–3 minutes, until tender.
Pour the beaten egg mixture over the mushrooms. Gently stir and spread to distribute evenly.
Cover for about 1 minute if you prefer a firmer omelette.
Slide onto a plate and serve with Salade Verte.

title: Tamagoyaki - Japanese Rolled Omelette
directions: Crack eggs into a bowl, add milk and salt. Whisk until just combined.
Pass the mixture through a fine sieve into another bowl. This removes the chalaza and creates a smoother texture.
Add finely diced carrots, onions, spring onion, and a pinch of ground pepper. Stir gently.
Lightly grease a rectangular tamagoyaki pan (or small non-stick pan) with oil. Heat over medium-low heat.
Pour about 1/3 of the egg mixture into the pan. Tilt to spread evenly.
When the surface is just barely set, roll the egg toward you using chopsticks or a spatula.
Push the roll back to the far end of the pan. Add another 1/3 of the egg mixture, lifting the roll so it flows underneath.
When set again, roll toward you, incorporating the new layer. Repeat with the final third.
Shape the finished roll gently and let cool slightly before slicing and serving.

title: Egg Salad Recipe
directions: Shell the hard-boiled eggs and dice into small, even pieces.
Add diced pickles, celery, and salt to the eggs.
Add mayonnaise and toss everything together gently until combined.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.
Serve chilled as a sandwich filling or on its own.

title: Asian Vegetable Omelette
directions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add mushrooms and cook, stirring, for 2–3 minutes until tender. Transfer to a bowl.
Add red pepper and carrot to the pan. Cook and stir for 2 minutes.
Add 2 tablespoons water, cover, and cook for 1–2 more minutes until vegetables are tender.
Add spring onions, cook for 1 minute, then transfer everything to the mushroom bowl. Cover to keep warm.
For each omelette: whisk 3 eggs in a bowl and season with salt and pepper.
Heat 1 teaspoon of oil in a small nonstick pan over medium heat. Pour in the whisked eggs, tilting to cover the base.
Cook for about 1 minute, until the bottom is golden.
Spoon 1/4 of the vegetable mixture and 1/4 of the bean sprouts onto one side of the omelette.
Fold the omelette over the filling and cook for 1–2 more minutes until heated through.
Slide onto a plate and accompany with mixed greens. Repeat for remaining omelettes.

title: Aijet Beythat (Egg Kabab)
directions: Hard-boil and peel the eggs.
Prick the whites all over with a toothpick or skewer so they will not split when heated.
Mix salt, paprika, black pepper, and cinnamon together in a small bowl. Set aside.
Melt butter in a skillet over low heat.
Add eggs to the skillet and sauté gently, turning occasionally, until lightly browned on all sides.
Transfer eggs to a serving plate and sprinkle the seasoning mixture over them.
Serve immediately.

title: Spicy Egg Salad Sandwiches
directions: Hard-boil and chop the eggs.
Combine eggs, green chilies, mayonnaise, green onions, and hot pepper sauce in a medium bowl.
Season with salt and ground black pepper. Stir until evenly mixed.
Toast the bagels or English muffins.
Spread the spicy egg salad generously over each toasted half.
Serve immediately.

title: Bacon-Egg Salad Sandwiches
directions: Hard-boil and chop the eggs.
In a bowl, combine chopped eggs, diced radishes, mayonnaise, horseradish sauce, and black pepper. Mix well.
Toast the bread slices if desired.
Spread the egg salad evenly onto 2 slices of bread.
Layer 3 bacon strips on top of each.
Close with the remaining bread slices.
Cut diagonally and serve.

title: Vegetable Beef Soup
directions: Place chuck roast in a crock-pot. Cover with water and add onion soup mix and tomato juice.
Cook on LOW all day (8–10 hours) or overnight.
Remove the meat from the broth and let cool. Skim any fat from the top of the broth.
Transfer broth to a large roaster or soup pot.
Add barley, carrots, celery, and beef broth. Simmer slowly until carrots are slightly tender, about 20 minutes.
Add lima beans, corn, and green beans. Continue to cook for another 15 minutes.
Add finely cut cabbage and simmer until tender, about 10 minutes.
Add frozen peas and stir.
Meanwhile, trim all fat from the cooled meat and cut into small pieces.
Add the meat back to the pot. Simmer everything together for 10–15 more minutes.
Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper enough. Serve hot.

title: Beef Stew (Hearty)
directions: Combine flour and 1 tsp salt in a plastic bag. Add meat cubes a few at a time and shake to coat.
Heat oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the flour-coated meat on all sides. Work in batches to avoid steaming.
Add onion, garlic, and thyme. Stir and cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in the vegetable juice cocktail, bouillon, hot pepper sauce, and 1 cup water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer until meat is nearly tender, about 1 hour.
Add potatoes, celery, and carrots. Stir to combine.
Cover and continue simmering for another 25–30 minutes, or until vegetables are tender.
Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper. Serve hot.

title: Beef Rendang

ingredients.name: dark palm sugar or brown sugar

directions: Soak dried chili peppers in boiling water for 30 minutes until softened.
Toast the desiccated coconut in a large dry skillet over medium heat for 2–3 minutes, stirring, until golden. Transfer to a blender.
Toast the coriander and cumin seeds in the same pan for 2–3 minutes until fragrant. Add to blender.
Add soaked chilies, ginger, galangal, turmeric, shallots, garlic, and chopped lemongrass to the blender.
Blend until roughly chopped, then add 1/2 cup water and blend until a smooth paste forms.
Heat oil in the same pan over medium heat. Cook the curry paste, stirring, for 2–3 minutes until very fragrant.
Add beef in batches and cook, stirring, for 3–4 minutes per batch until browned. Return all beef to the pan.
Add coconut water, coconut milk, tamarind paste, cinnamon stick, kaffir lime leaves, palm sugar, and reserved lemongrass stalks. Stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and cook covered for 1 hour.
Remove the lid and simmer uncovered for a further 1.5 hours, stirring occasionally, until the beef is very tender and the sauce has thickened and darkened.
Remove and discard cinnamon stick and lemongrass stalks. Season enough.
Serve with steamed rice and extra kaffir lime leaves.

title: Japanese Beef Curry

ingredients.name: Japanese curry roux (boxed)
ingredients.alternative: S&B Golden Curry or homemade curry roux

ingredients.name: carrots
ingredients.measurement: 4 medium, peeled and cut into chunks

directions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Sauté garlic until golden brown.
Add diced onion and cook, stirring, until caramelized, about 10 minutes.
Add canned mushrooms and stir for 1–2 minutes.
Add the beef pieces and stir to let the flavors coat the meat. Cook for 3–4 minutes.
Pour in 8 cups of water. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer until meat is tender, about 45–60 minutes.
Peel and cut potatoes and carrots into chunks. Add to the pot.
Continue simmering until vegetables are cooked through, about 15–20 minutes.
Break the curry roux block apart. Add to the pot and stir until completely dissolved and the soup thickens.
Season with black pepper and salt enough.
Serve over steamed white rice.

title: Korean New Year's Beef-Rice Cake Soup
directions: Soak rice cake slices in cold water for 1 hour while preparing the beef.
Slice beef into thin strips with a sharp knife.
Combine soy sauce, sesame seeds, garlic, salt, and pepper in a small bowl. Add beef strips and toss to coat.
In a large soup pot, stir-fry the marinated beef over medium-high heat until it begins to brown.
Pour the beef broth into the pot. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 45 minutes.
Separate any frozen or stuck rice cake slices before adding.
Add the rice cakes and sliced green onions to the soup.
Cook until rice cakes rise to the surface, about 20–25 minutes. Do not overcook — they should remain chewy.
Pour the beaten egg into the bubbling soup and stir well. The egg will cook immediately.
Serve hot.

title: Tamarind Beef

ingredients.name: tamarind concentrate
ingredients.alternative: asam jawa paste dissolved in warm water

directions: In a large shallow bowl, combine 1/4 cup sesame oil, 1/4 cup sugar, and 2 tablespoons salt.
Add the beef tenderloin and turn to coat in the marinade. Let stand at room temperature for 1 hour.
In a medium saucepan, combine water, tamarind concentrate, fish sauce, and remaining 1/4 cup sugar.
Bring to a boil over high heat. Stir occasionally and cook until sugar is dissolved and sauce reduces to about 1 cup, about 12 minutes. Remove from heat and keep warm.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Add shallots and cook until browned and crispy, about 2 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon to a plate.
Drain the beef from the marinade. Divide remaining shallot oil into two large skillets.
Add beef in batches to each skillet in a single even layer. Cook over high heat, turning once, until browned, about 2 minutes per batch.
Transfer all browned beef to a serving platter.
Pour the warm tamarind sauce over the beef and top with the crispy fried shallots.
Serve immediately.

title: Ginger-Lime Beef Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: beef sirloin
ingredients.measurement: 1 lb, thinly sliced across the grain

ingredients.name: red bell pepper
ingredients.measurement: 1, seeded and cut into thin strips

directions: Rinse and seed the bell pepper, trim white veins, and cut into strips about 1/4 inch wide and 2 inches long.
Rinse beef and pat dry. Cut across the grain into thin slices, then cut into bite-size pieces.
Heat oil in a large nonstick frying pan or wok over high heat.
Add bell pepper and stir-fry until tender-crisp, about 3 minutes. Transfer to a bowl.
Add beef to the pan over high heat and stir-fry until no longer pink, about 2 minutes.
Using a slotted spoon, transfer beef to the bowl with the pepper.
Add lime juice, honey, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, ginger, and chili flakes to the pan juices.
Boil over high heat, stirring often, until the sauce reduces to about 1/3 cup, about 5–6 minutes.
Return beef and pepper to the pan. Stir until hot, about 30 seconds.
Spoon onto a serving platter and sprinkle with fresh cilantro. Serve immediately.

title: Spicy Beef Patties With Pepper Sauce And Hand-Cut Fries
directions: Heat 4 1/4 cups vegetable oil in a large deep pan to 325°F (165°C). Fry potato strips in batches for 5–6 minutes (first fry). Remove and set aside. Keep oil warm.
For the sauce: heat 1 tbsp sunflower oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add diced peppers and 2 diced onions. Sauté for 4–5 minutes.
Stir in tomato purée and cook for 1–2 minutes.
Sprinkle 1 1/2 tablespoons flour over the mixture and stir. Gradually pour in the stock and bring to a boil.
Simmer, stirring, for 4–5 minutes until thickened. Stir in half the oregano and the pinch of sugar. Season enough. Set aside and keep warm.
For the patties: combine ground beef, diced chilli, paprika, remaining diced onion, mustard, egg, breadcrumbs, and milk in a bowl. Season well and mix.
Shape into 4 patties, about 3/4 inch thick.
Heat 2 tbsp sunflower oil in a frying pan. Cook patties over medium heat for 8–9 minutes, turning once, until cooked through.
Increase oil to 375°F (190°C). Fry the potatoes a second time in batches for 3–4 minutes until golden and crisp. Drain and season with salt and pepper.
Dust 1 tbsp flour over sliced onion rings and fry in the hot oil for 1–2 minutes until golden.
To serve: spoon pepper sauce onto each plate, top with a beef patty, and add fries on the side. Garnish with onion rings.

title: Asian-Style Beef Skewers with Rice Noodles

ingredients.name: low-sodium soy sauce
ingredients.alternative: regular soy sauce, diluted with water

ingredients.name: chili sauce (Thai or sweet chili)
ingredients.alternative: sambal manis or sweet chili sauce

directions: Combine soy sauce, sugar, chili sauce, vegetable oil, and lime juice in a zip-top bag.
Add beef to the bag, seal, and marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes, turning once.
Remove steak from bag and reserve the marinade.
Thread steak evenly onto soaked skewers.
Grill skewers for 2 minutes on each side or until cooked to desired doneness.
Combine reserved marinade and 1/2 cup water in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil and cook for 1 minute. Set aside.
Place rice stick noodles in a heatproof bowl and cover with boiling water. Let soak until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain.
Transfer noodles to a large serving bowl and pour the cooked marinade mixture over them. Toss to coat.
Top with shredded green onions and serve alongside the beef skewers.

title: Beef In Mustard Sauce

ingredients.name: Dijon-style mustard
ingredients.alternative: yellow mustard or mustard powder paste

directions: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok over high heat.
Add beef strips and stir-fry until done, about 1–2 minutes. Transfer to a warm platter.
Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon oil in the wok.
Add green onions and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add beef broth, Dijon mustard, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper to the wok.
Bring to a rolling boil, stirring to combine.
Return the cooked beef to the wok and toss to coat in the sauce.
Pour over the warm platter or serve directly over rice.

title: Thai Beef Salad (Yum Nuea)
directions: Rub steak with olive oil, salt, and pepper. If refrigerated, let sit at room temperature for 20 minutes.
Preheat grill to high heat.
Grill steak on high heat for 7 minutes per side with the top open.
Transfer to a plate, cover with foil, and let rest for at least 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine cilantro, green onions, mint, shallots, cucumber, sesame oil, chili oil, thai bird peppers, lime juice, and fish sauce in a large bowl. Mix well.
After resting, slice the steak very thin across the grain. It should be rare to medium-rare.
Add the steak slices to the salad mixture and toss to combine.
Serve immediately with steamed white rice.

title: Orange Peel Beef
directions: Combine 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp sugar for the marinade. Marinate beef slices for 10 minutes.
Mix the sauce ingredients (soy sauce, sugar, vinegar, sesame oil) in a small bowl. Set aside.
Add egg and flour to the marinated beef and mix with your hands until each piece is well coated.
Heat oil for deep frying. Carefully slide beef pieces in one at a time to prevent sticking.
Fry until crispy, about 3–4 minutes. Remove and drain. Fry all beef a second time briefly for extra crispiness. Drain on paper towels.
Remove most of the oil from the wok, leaving about 2 tablespoons.
Stir-fry dried chili peppers and orange peel over high heat until they begin to darken, about 1–2 minutes.
Pour in the sauce and bring to a boil.
Add the dissolved cornstarch and stir until the sauce thickens.
Add the crispy beef and stir-fry for 1 minute to coat.
Remove peppers before serving if desired. Serve over rice.

title: Tender Beef Steak
directions: Grate about 1 tablespoon of fresh pineapple.
Coat both sides of the steak with grated pineapple. Let marinate for 1 hour.
Remove pineapple from the meat and season with salt and coarsely ground black pepper.
Heat a frying pan over high heat. Add olive oil and grated garlic and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add steak to the pan. Sear for 2–3 minutes per side for medium-rare, or adjust to your preference.
Add pineapple slices to the pan and sauté alongside the steak.
Transfer steak to a cutting board and let rest for 3–5 minutes.
Slice and serve with pineapple slices and a side of wasabi.

title: Red Beef Curry With Hokkien Noodles
directions: Heat half the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat.
Stir-fry beef in 2 batches, tossing frequently, for about 2 minutes per batch until just sealed. Transfer to a bowl.
Reduce heat to medium. Add remaining oil, onion, and curry paste. Cook for 2 minutes until aromatic.
Add sliced capsicum, coconut milk, and water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 3 minutes.
Add bok choy and cook for 2–3 minutes until just tender.
Place noodles in a heatproof bowl, cover with boiling water, and let stand for 2 minutes to soften. Drain.
Return beef to the wok. Add drained noodles, fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, and spring onions.
Toss everything to combine and heat through for 1–2 minutes.
Serve immediately.

title: Vegetarian (Or Not) Egg Rolls

ingredients.name: sweet chili or soy dipping sauce

directions: Stir-fry ground chicken (or tofu) with ginger in a large skillet over medium-high heat until browned, about 2–3 minutes.
Add cabbage, bean sprouts, green onions, and shredded carrot.
Cook for 2 more minutes, stirring frequently.
Stir in oyster sauce. Mix well and let the filling cool completely.
Lay an egg roll wrapper flat with one corner pointing toward you (like a diamond).
Place 2 tablespoons of filling in the center. Fold the bottom corner up over the filling.
Fold in the side corners, then brush the top corner with egg white.
Roll tightly upward to seal. Repeat with remaining wrappers and filling.
Brush the outside of each roll with egg white for extra crispiness.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Lightly spray with cooking spray.
Pan-fry rolls in batches, turning occasionally, until golden brown on all sides, about 5–7 minutes.
Serve warm with dipping sauce.

title: Death To Dieters Chicken Lasagna
directions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Spray a deep 9x13 baking pan with cooking spray.
Cook lasagna noodles in boiling salted water until al dente. Drain and run cold water over them to stop cooking.
Cook chicken breasts in a nonstick skillet sprayed with cooking spray until fully cooked. Slice into thin strips.
In the same skillet, sauté mushrooms and onions until soft, about 5 minutes.
Prepare hollandaise sauce according to package directions.
Spread a thin layer of hollandaise over the bottom of the baking pan.
Layer noodles on top, then half the chicken. Season with basil, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Add half the mushroom-onion mixture and drizzle with half the remaining hollandaise.
Sprinkle with half of the mozzarella and Parmesan cheeses.
Lay all the asparagus in an even layer over the cheese.
Repeat layers: noodles, remaining chicken (seasoned), remaining mushrooms, remaining hollandaise, ending with both cheeses.
Bake uncovered for 45–60 minutes, until hot and bubbly. If cheese begins to brown too much, tent loosely with foil.
Let stand 15 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Egg Fu Yung (Chicken)
directions: Beat eggs until foamy in a large bowl. Add 1 tsp salt and chicken broth. Beat again and set aside.
Heat 6 tablespoons of oil in a large frying pan over high heat.
Add crab, ham, mushrooms, bean sprouts, bamboo shoots, and green onion. Stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add soy sauce and remaining 1 tsp salt. Stir-fry for another 30 seconds. Remove from pan.
Pour remaining 2 tablespoons of oil into the pan and swirl to coat.
Pour in egg mixture and let it set for about 1 minute without stirring.
Fold the cooked egg over itself like an omelette. Flip and cook for another 30 seconds until eggs are set.
Remove to a plate and serve with Egg Fu Yung sauce.

title: Smoky Sausage Chicken
directions: Combine flour and pepper in a plastic bag. Add chicken pieces and shake to coat. Reserve leftover flour mixture.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Brown chicken on all sides, about 10 minutes. Remove to a plate.
In the same skillet, add chopped onion and garlic. Cook over medium heat for 3 minutes.
Add sausage slices, celery, and Cajun seasoning. Cook for 1–5 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Sprinkle the reserved flour mixture over and stir.
Add canned tomatoes (mash slightly with a fork) and diced bell pepper. Bring to a boil.
Return chicken to the pan. Reduce heat to low.
Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, for about 35 minutes until chicken is fully cooked through.
Serve garnished with sliced green onions.

title: Braised Chicken

ingredients.name: chicken broth
ingredients.alternative: chicken broth cube dissolved in water

directions: Pat chicken dry and season with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large, deep pan over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and brown on both sides, about 4–5 minutes per side. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add onion, garlic, red bell pepper, and celery. Sauté until softened, about 4 minutes.
Add dried rosemary and thyme. Stir for 30 seconds.
Mix tomato paste with chicken broth and pour into the pan along with canned tomatoes. Stir well.
Return chicken to the pan. Add potatoes and parsley.
Cover and cook on low heat for 30–35 minutes, adding more broth as needed to keep moist.
Add frozen peas in the last 5 minutes and stir.
Serve hot with bread.

title: Guppy's Chicken Noodle Soup

ingredients.name: wide egg noodles
ingredients.alternative: regular egg noodles or mie telur

directions: Place whole chicken in a large stock pot. Cover with water until fully submerged.
Bring to a boil over high heat, then cook until chicken is fully cooked through, about 30–45 minutes.
Remove chicken from the pot. Do not discard the water.
To the pot, add onion, celery, chicken broth, parsley flakes, garlic, pepper, bouillon granules, and salt.
Reduce heat to low and let simmer while you prepare the chicken.
Remove skin from chicken and debone. Shred meat into bite-sized pieces.
Add shredded chicken back to the pot. Simmer for 30 minutes.
Add egg noodles and butter. Stir and cook until noodles are soft, about 15 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning. Serve hot.

title: Grilled Chicken Breast with Ginger and Soy
directions: In the bottom of each of 2 large freezer bags, combine 1/2 cup soy sauce, 2 tablespoons olive oil, 1 tablespoon sesame oil, half the lime juice, ginger, garlic, and 2 tablespoons cilantro.
Place 2 chicken breasts in each bag. Seal, removing as much air as possible, and shake to coat.
Marinate for at least 1 hour at room temperature, or refrigerate for up to 24 hours.
Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Oil the grates with a folded paper towel dipped in oil.
Remove chicken from marinade and season with salt and pepper.
Grill for 3–5 minutes per side until charred on the outside and cooked through (165°F / 74°C internally).
Serve alongside sesame noodles and cucumber pickles, garnished with remaining cilantro.

title: Chicken 65
directions: Combine chicken with chili powder, turmeric, ginger paste, garlic paste, black pepper, and salt in a bowl. Marinate for 1 hour if possible.
Add egg and cornflour to the marinated chicken. Mix well until everything is evenly coated.
Heat oil for deep frying over medium-high heat. Fry chicken pieces in batches until light golden brown. Drain and set aside.
Whisk together yogurt, a pinch of salt, and a dash of chili powder in a bowl. Set near the stove.
As you take chicken pieces from the oil, immediately dip them into the yogurt mixture.
In a separate pan, heat 1 teaspoon oil over high heat for tempering.
Add slit green chilies and curry leaves. Cover immediately — the oil will splutter. Fry until slightly charred, lowering the heat carefully.
Remove the pan from heat. Add the chicken and yogurt mixture.
Return to low heat and cook, stirring, until the yogurt liquid evaporates and a dry, clinging curry coats the chicken.
Serve hot.

title: Lightly Spiced Crispy Chicken

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.alternative: vegetable or sunflower oil for frying

directions: On a large plate, combine breadcrumbs, onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, oregano, salt, and pepper. Mix with fingers.
Pour milk into one shallow bowl and the whisked egg into another.
Pat chicken dry.
Dip each piece into the milk, then into the whisked egg, then coat thoroughly with the breadcrumb mixture.
Repeat with all chicken pieces and place on a clean plate. Let rest for 5 minutes so the coating adheres.
In a large heavy-bottomed skillet, heat about 1 inch of oil over medium-high heat for about 5 minutes.
Carefully add chicken pieces to the hot oil. Cook for about 3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Transfer to a plate lined with paper towels to drain.
Repeat with remaining chicken pieces.
Serve immediately.

title: Spicy Red Rice with Chicken and Vegetables
directions: Heat oil in a large heavy pot over medium-high heat. Season chicken with salt and pepper.
Add chicken, bell peppers, onion, garlic, and oregano to the pot. Sauté for 5 minutes.
Stir in paprika and cayenne pepper.
Add uncooked rice and stir to coat it in the oil and spices.
Pour in 2 cups chicken broth and tomato sauce. Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce heat to medium-low.
Simmer for about 25 minutes, checking occasionally. If the mixture looks dry, add more broth 1/4 cup at a time.
When chicken and rice are tender and liquid is absorbed, stir in frozen peas.
Cook for 2 more minutes until peas are heated through.
Season enough with salt and pepper and serve.

title: Chicken Broccoli Macaroni and Cheese

ingredients.name: whole milk
ingredients.alternative: evaporated milk or UHT full fat milk

directions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
In a skillet, heat olive oil over medium-high heat. Add diced chicken, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring, for 7–10 minutes until cooked through. Set aside.
Cook pasta according to package directions, adding broccoli florets in the last 3 minutes. Drain and set aside.
In a medium saucepan, melt butter over medium heat.
Whisk in flour, cayenne, and paprika. Cook, whisking, until the mixture bubbles.
Gradually whisk in milk and chicken broth.
Raise heat to bring to a quick boil, then lower and simmer until sauce thickens, about 5 minutes.
Add Dijon mustard to the sauce and stir.
Add shredded cheddar and stir until completely melted, about 2 minutes.
Combine cooked pasta, broccoli, and chicken in the pasta pot. Pour cheese sauce over and stir to coat.
Serve hot.

title: Sweet 'N Sour Chicken
directions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken and sauté until lightly browned, about 4–5 minutes.
Add garlic, bell pepper, and carrot strips. Stir-fry for 2–3 minutes.
Add bouillon, soy sauce, vinegar, brown sugar, ginger, and pineapple with juice. Stir to combine.
Bring to a full boil.
Stir in instant rice. Mix well.
Cover the pan and remove from heat.
Let stand for 5 minutes until rice absorbs the liquid.
Fluff with a fork before serving.

title: Hawaiian Chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 200°F (93°C) to keep chicken warm.
Mix salt, pepper, and flour on a plate. Dredge each chicken breast in the mixture.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear each side of the chicken until golden brown.
Transfer chicken to an oven-safe plate and keep warm in the oven.
Cut carrots lengthwise into quarters, then halve crosswise. Sauté in the same skillet with 1 tablespoon soy sauce, salt, pepper, garlic, and ginger until semi-soft.
Remove carrots from skillet and finish in the microwave for 2–3 minutes until tender.
For the sauce: in the same cleaned skillet, combine pineapple chunks and juice, brown sugar, remaining 2 tablespoons soy sauce, ginger, cloves, and paprika.
Stir over medium heat and add flour gradually until sauce reaches desired consistency.
Place chicken on a plate, pour sauce over the top, and add carrots.
Serve with cooked white rice.

title: Chicken Ramen Noodle Salad
directions: Cook ramen noodles in at least 6 cups of boiling water for 3 minutes (discard flavoring packets or save for another use).
Drain, run cold water over noodles to cool, then drain again.
Toss noodles with sesame oil. Refrigerate while preparing other ingredients.
In a large salad bowl, combine apple, pineapple, celery, cucumber, green onions, craisins, sunflower seeds, and sesame seeds.
In a small jar or shaker, combine water, soy sauce, vinegar, brown sugar, ginger, and cayenne. Shake well.
Add cooled noodles and shredded chicken to the salad bowl.
Pour dressing over and toss everything together until evenly coated.
Refrigerate for 1 hour for best flavor, tossing occasionally. Can also be served immediately.

title: Pineapple Chicken Stir Fry
directions: In a small bowl, whisk together pineapple juice, soy sauce, brown sugar, and cornstarch. Set aside.
Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a wok or large frying pan over medium heat.
Add chicken chunks and garlic. Stir and toss frequently until chicken is cooked through, about 6–8 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Add peppers to the same pan. Stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add 2 tablespoons water, cover the pan, and cook for 2–3 minutes until peppers are tender.
Return chicken to the pan along with the pineapple chunks.
Pour the pineapple juice sauce mixture over everything. Stir to coat.
Cook for another 8–10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens.
Serve over rice.

title: Shrimp Egg Rolls
directions: Cut shrimp into small pieces. Combine with cornstarch, salt, and 4 Tbsp. soy sauce. Mix well. Set aside.
Heat 4 Tbsp. oil in a wok over high heat. Add shrimp and stir-fry until pink, about 2 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Add 4 Tbsp. oil to the wok. Add grated ginger root and stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add cabbage and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add onions and 4 Tbsp. soy sauce. Stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add carrots and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add bean sprouts and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Return cooked shrimp to the wok. Mix well and stir-fry for 1 more minute.
Transfer filling to a colander and let drain and cool completely.
Fill egg roll wrappers according to package instructions, using about 2 tablespoons of filling each.
Seal edges with a dab of water. Deep-fry in hot oil at 350°F (175°C) until golden brown, about 3–4 minutes.

title: Fried Rice Omelette

ingredients.name: ham
ingredients.alternative: smoked beef or chicken sausage, diced

directions: Wash and dice the onion. Rinse and dice the ham. Blanch green beans and dice the carrot.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok or pan. Sauté onion until softened.
Add cooked rice and stir-fry until heated through.
Add green beans, ham, and carrot. Stir-fry together.
Season with soy sauce and salt. Stir-fry until everything is well combined and done. Remove fried rice and set aside.
In the same pan, heat remaining oil over medium heat.
Beat eggs and pour into pan. Tilt pan to spread eggs into a thin, even omelette.
Place the fried rice on one side of the omelette.
Fold the other half over the rice, press gently to seal, and fry until the bottom is golden.
Flip once and cook briefly. Slide onto a plate and serve.

title: Omu Rice (Japanese Omelette)

ingredients.name: bacon strips
ingredients.alternative: smoked beef strips or sosis sapi

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.measurement: 2 tsp. (for vegetables) + 1 tsp. per serving (for omelette)

directions: Combine diced carrots, capsicum, onions, and bacon in a bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk 2 eggs per serving with 1/2 tsp sugar, a drop of oil, and a pinch of salt. Set aside.
Heat 2 teaspoons of oil in a deep saucepan. Add the vegetable and bacon mixture and cook for 5–10 minutes until tender.
Add cooked rice and stir well to combine.
Add tomato paste and stir until fully incorporated. Cook for 2 more minutes. Remove from heat.
For each serving: heat 1 teaspoon oil in a large nonstick frying pan. Brush to coat the base.
Pour in 1/4 of the egg mixture and tilt pan to spread evenly. Cook for about 2 minutes.
Scrape edges away from the pan. Add 1/4 of the rice mixture to one side of the egg.
Fold the other side of the egg over the rice.
Invert a plate over the pan and flip over so the omelette lands on the plate seam-side down.
Garnish with tomato ketchup. Repeat for remaining 3 servings.

title: Egg Fu Yong I
directions: Lightly beat the eggs with sesame oil, sugar, dark soy sauce, and a pinch of salt in a large bowl. Set aside.
Heat 3 tablespoons oil in a wok over high heat. Stir-fry onions for 1 minute.
Add mushrooms and shredded bamboo shoot. Stir-fry until cooked, about 2 minutes.
Add shrimp. Stir-fry until they change color, about 1–2 minutes.
Remove all ingredients from the wok and combine them with the pork and egg mixture in the bowl. Stir well.
Heat 6 tablespoons oil in a large pan. Swirl to coat the pan evenly.
Pour in the entire egg mixture. Quickly spread and stir to distribute ingredients evenly.
Once the edges begin to set, stop stirring and let the omelette form.
Lightly flatten into a large pancake. Add a bit more oil around the edges if needed.
Cook until the bottom is golden brown, then carefully flip and cook the other side until golden.
Slide onto a plate and serve.

title: Ridiculously Easy Egg Sandwich
directions: Melt 1/2 tsp butter in a small heavy skillet over medium-low heat.
Break both eggs into the skillet one on top of the other so they form one mass. Break the yolks and let them spread over the whites.
Season with a dash of black pepper and herb-seasoned salt.
Cook until about 2/3 done, then flip with a spatula. Gently press and shape the eggs to roughly the size of the bread.
Lay cheese slices on top and let melt.
Lightly spread remaining butter or mayonnaise on one slice of bread.
Place eggs with melted cheese onto bread. Top with bacon and pickles if desired.
Close with the second bread slice. Serve immediately.

title: Cheesy Egg Quesadilla With Poblano Corn Relish
directions: Preheat a skillet to medium heat. Crack eggs into a bowl and whisk with the half-and-half. Add salt and pepper.
Pour eggs into the skillet. Stir gently and cook until scrambled and just set, about 2–3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Preheat a panini press or a separate skillet.
Lay a tortilla flat. Fill one half with about 1/4 of the scrambled eggs and 1/4 of the shredded cheese.
Fold the tortilla into a half moon and press in the panini maker (or cook in a skillet, pressing down, for about 1 minute per side) until cheese melts.
Remove to a plate and cut into triangles. Repeat with remaining tortillas.
For the relish: heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add poblano pepper, shallot, garlic, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Cook until softened.
Add corn and cook until golden, about 3–4 minutes. Remove from heat and pour into a bowl.
Let cool slightly, then stir in avocado, cilantro, and lemon juice. Season enough.
Top each quesadilla with poblano corn relish and serve.

title: Homemade Omelette Appetizer

ingredients.name: hot chili peppers
ingredients.alternative: red bird's eye chili (cabai rawit merah)

directions: Beat eggs in a small bowl with a fork for 1–2 minutes until well combined.
Heat olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add red onion, garlic, and chili. Sauté until onion softens, about 2 minutes.
Add flaked salmon and mashed potatoes. Stir to combine until heated through.
Season with salt and pepper. Mix well, then remove from heat and let cool slightly.
Add the beaten eggs to the salmon-potato mixture and stir until thoroughly combined.
Lightly grease a 7-inch nonstick pan with butter or cooking spray over medium heat.
Pour in the egg mixture. Cover with a lid and cook for 5 minutes until the omelette sets.
Flip the omelette and cook the other side for 2–3 minutes.
Remove from pan and cut into 8 triangles.
Place each triangle on a bread slice and serve with tomato sauce or green chutney.

title: Tuna Egg Salad Bento Box
directions: For the tuna-egg salad: combine tuna, mayonnaise, chopped eggs, onion, pickle chips, and salt in a bowl. Mix well.
Slice the tops of cherry tomatoes and hollow them out slightly. Fill with tuna-egg salad. Set aside.
For the fruit kebabs: slice banana and dip in lemon juice to prevent browning. Thread banana, pineapple chunk, and strawberry onto toothpicks. Repeat.
For the tulip carrots: cut carrots and cucumbers into 3/4-inch circles. Using a small knife, shape carrot circles into tulip flowers. Trim cucumber slices into leaves. Thread onto toothpicks.
For the flower cut-outs: cut remaining carrot and cucumber slices and use a mini flower-shaped vegetable cutter.
For the heart-shaped egg: place a hot hard-boiled egg in a heart-shaped egg mold, close tightly, and soak in cold water for 10 minutes. Remove and drain.
Arrange all components in a bento box: tuna-stuffed tomatoes, fruit kebabs, vegetable tulips, flower cut-outs, and heart-shaped egg.

title: Apple Cheese Omelette
directions: In an 8-inch nonstick skillet with sloping sides, heat butter over medium heat.
Add apple slices in a single layer. Cook for 2 minutes.
Sprinkle with 1 tsp sugar and a pinch of cinnamon. Continue cooking until tender, about 3–5 more minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together eggs, remaining 1 tsp sugar, and 1 tsp water until just blended.
Pour the egg mixture over the apples in the skillet.
Stir gently with a spatula to let the egg mixture cover the bottom of the pan.
Use the spatula to gently push cooked portions to the center, tilting the pan so uncooked egg flows into the empty spaces.
When the egg is almost set on the surface, sprinkle cheese over one half of the omelette.
Slip spatula under the unfilled side and fold over the cheese side.
Slide onto a serving plate. Sprinkle with cinnamon sugar and serve immediately.

title: Quickie Beef Stew

ingredients.name: onion soup
ingredients.alternative: homemade: onion flakes + beef stock powder

directions: Drain vegetables, reserving liquid.
Combine flour and soup. Mix in large skillet.
Add water and reserved liquid to make 3 cups.
Stir into mixture in skillet.
Heat to boiling, stirring constantly.
Boil and stir 1 minute.
Stir in vegetables and beef. Cover over low heat, about 10 minutes or until done.

title: Chopped Beef Sandwiches
directions: Mix all ingredients except rolls.
Spread on rolls.

title: Shortcut Corned Beef And Cabbage

ingredients.name: corned beef
ingredients.alternative: fresh corned beef, cooked and shredded

directions: Fry bacon and tear into bite sized pieces.
Drain off all but about 2 T bacon grease.
Slice onion if using and add to pan along with cabbage which has been cut into medium-sized pieces.
Begin sauteing the above.
Open the cans of corned beef and"chunk" the meat, either with a fork or your fingers and add to the pan of cabbage and onion.
Continue cooking until the cabbage and onion are soft and the meat is heated through.
Season very well with salt and pepper (to your taste).
Serve hot.

title: Spanish Rice With Beef
directions: Cook meat until brown.
Add corn, water, tomatoes and seasonings; bring to a boil.
Stir in rice, cover and remove from heat.
Let stand 5 minutes.

title: Cajun Beef Burgers
directions: Divide ground chuck into 4 equal portions and form into patties, each 4" in diameter.
In small bowl, combine all the spices.
Press seasoning mixture into both sides of the patties.
Place a large, heavy, non-stick skillet over med-high heat for 5 minutes.
Cook patties in hot skillet 6 minutes, turning once.
Remove patties from skillet, increase heat to high, add onion rings and cook until tender-crisp; stirring constantly.
On each bun half, place a patty and onions.
Garnish with sour cream, or melt slices of pepper or onion cheese on patties.

title: Beef Steak with Black Pepper Sauce
directions: Bring the steak to room temperature.
Season with salt, black pepper, dry herbs and let sit about 30 minutes.
Slice onion into small pieces (would taste better if they are smaller than the ones in this picture.
I did this a bit clumsily today^^)
Add olive oil into the frying pan.
Fry each side of the steak in 90 seconds.
Transfer the steak to a cutting board.
Reuse the pan that was used to fry steak.
Add garlic and onion to simmer, add a teaspoon of sugar to make garlic and onion have a beautiful colour.
Add 2 teaspoons of black pepper and soy sauce to simmer into sauce.
To make the sauce glaze, add 1 teaspoon of tapioca starch (or corn starch)
Drizzle the sauce over the steak.
Enjoy :)

title: Pineapple Beef Marinade
directions: Add all the ingredients, stiring with wish making sure the sugar dissolves.
Allow to sit for an hour so the flavors blend.

title: Pan Roasted Chicken And Vegetables

ingredients.name: chicken broth
ingredients.alternative: chicken bouillon cube dissolved in 1/3 c. water

directions: *For reduced fat, use nonstick pan.
Remove chicken skin and reduce oil to 2 tablespoons.

title: Oriental Styled Chicken Rice Topping

ingredients.name: five-spice powder
ingredients.alternative: mix of cinnamon + clove + star anise (ground)

directions: Boil the water with the salt.
Add the rice and boil for about 5 minutes to give it stickiness and moisture. Remove and put it in a bowl.
Marinate the chicken in the soy sauce and pepper for about 10 minutes.
Mix the flour with the 5 spice powder, add the chicken and toss it around to coat it.
Fry the chicken for 3 mins on each side or until cooked.
Remove the chicken and drain oil with paper towels
Now cut the chicken into bite sized pieces and serve it on top of the rice that was boiled earlier.

title: Popcorn Chicken
directions: Mix flour, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper together in a bowl. Beat eggs and lemon juice together in a separate bowl.
Heat 1 1/2 to 2 inches of oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Dip the chicken pieces into the flour mixture, then the egg mixture, and again into the flour mixture.

Test the oil to make sure it is hot enough: a small amount of flour dropped in should sizzle. Place 10 pieces of chicken into the hot oil; cook until golden brown, about 8 minutes. Remove from the oil and drain on a paper towel lined plate and season with salt. Repeat with remaining chicken.

title: Chicken Rice
directions: Brown rice on a medium heat turning frequenty till very light brown
Add chicken broth and bouillon and stir well
Add seasonings and stirt
Turn up heat to medium high stiring freqently
Turn to low and cover when only a thin layer of liquid lays above the rice
cook 15 minutes
stir rice in the pan and revove from heat
cover and wait 3-5 minutes before eating

title: Spiced Chicken
directions: Pound Chicken into about 1/3" pieces.
Combine all seasonings in a bowl and mix.
Dip the chicken in butter until it's well-coated.
Sprinkle each fillet with about 1/2 a teaspoon of the seasoning mix.
Put the chicken in a skillet.
While cooking, put a little of the leftover butter on each fillet and cook for about 5 minutes.

title: Barbecue Chicken Rub
directions: Prepare grill.
Combine first 9 ingredients in a bowl, stirring well.
Loosen skin from chicken by inserting fingers, gently pushing between skin and meat; rub spice mixture evenly under skin over meat.
Lightly coat skin with cooking spray.
Place chicken, breast-side down, on a grill rack coated with cooking spray.
Grill 30 minutes or until a thermometer inserted in the thickest part registers 165F, turning twice.

title: Chicken Pineapple Stir- Fry
directions: Mix first 7 ingredients with reserved 1/4 cup pineapple juice in small bowl.
In large skillet, stir-fry chicken in hot oil 5 minutes.
Add vegetables, stir-fry 4 more minutes.
Stir in pineapple and sauce, heat through.
Serve over rice.

title: Sausage-Egg Casserole
directions: Brown sausage and drain well.
Pour scalded milk over bread crumbs.
Add onion, parsley, salt, pepper and eggs to bread crumb mixture.

title: Tuna, Cheese And Ketchup Omelette
directions: in a small bowl mix the egg well with a dash of water or milk (as you like it).
add salt and pepper.
melt the fat in small/medium non- stick frying pan.
when it is hot-pour egg in and fry first side (prepare as you would a regular omlette).

now work fast: after turning omlette over, sprinkle the tuna over half the area,squirt some ketchup over the whole area then place slice (or more) of cheese (you can use any type you like or grate some from a chunk) over the tuna.
fold "empty" half over the tuna+cheese and press lightly.
You can flip it over again if you like it well done.
remove to plate and enjoy with a nice green salad and fresh bread.

title: Egg Fried Rice

ingredients.name: rice vinegar
ingredients.alternative: white vinegar or apple cider vinegar

directions: Place rice in a medium saucepan. Cover with 1/2 cup water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 15 mins, or until water is absorbed and rice is tender. Let cool.
Heat 1/2 tbsp oil in wok. Add 1/2 of the eggs and tilt wok to coat. Cook until omelette is set. Remove from pan and roll up tightly. Repeat with remaining eggs. Slice omelettes thinly.

Add remaining oil to wok. Stir-fry garlic, ginger and chili until fragrant. Add vegetables and stir-fry until tender. Add rice, soy sauce, vinegar and bean sprouts. Stir-fry until hot. Season. Add 2 green onions and toss to combine.
Serve rice topped with remaining green onions and sliced omelettes.

title: Omelette
directions: Crack the eggs into large bowl, mix until slightly bubbly
Add milk into egg mixture, stir, and set aside
Cut up the sausages unto small pieces, set aside
Melt the butter with vegetable oil in the pan with medium heat
Put the diced onion and sausages, stir fry but not until fully cooked
Pour the egg mixture to the pan
Add the shredded cheddar cheese
Add salt and pepper enough (optional)
Serve with toast bread

title: Potato And Onion Hash With A Fried Egg (For One)
directions: Place a large nonstick skillet over medium heat and add oil.
When oil is hot, add onion and a sprinkling of salt; stir until onion begins to soften, about 1 minute.
Add potato and cayenne to pan; reduce heat to low and cook, stirring frequently, until potatoes and onions are tender, caramelized and lightly browned, about 30 minutes.
Push potato and onion hash to one side of the pan and increase the heat.
Crack egg into pan and cook enough.
Spoon potatoes and onions onto a plate and top with the egg.

title: 2-minute noodle omelette

ingredients.name: noodles
ingredients.alternative: Indomie or any local curry instant noodles

directions: boil the water then add in the noodles.
(just the noodles).
beat the eggs together with seasoning, onions and chilli in a large bowl.
put aside.
drain the noodles when cooked.
put in the noodles in the bowl with the eggs and mix well.
u can pt mixed veges if u want
heat pan with oil(low heat so it cooks thoroughly) and fry like u fry your usual egg omelette.

title: Egg Salad Sandwich

ingredients.name: Jalapeno Peppers
ingredients.alternative: green bird's eye chilies (cabai rawit hijau), finely diced

directions: Peel the hard boiled eggs, cut them into 4 quarters and toss into a large mixing bowl.
Add the mayonnaise, mustard, jalapeno peppers, garlic salt and chili powder to the bowl.
Combine with a masher (for a smooth finish) or fork (for a chunkier finish) until fully combined.
Taste to see if additional garlic salt is needed.
Scoop some onto a slice of bread and top as desired.
Optional fixings: Cut the avocado and add 2-3 slices to the top of the bread followed by a large scoop of the egg mixture.
Add any other garnish you prefer including paprika, lettuce and tomato slices.
Cover with a second slice of bread and cut on the diagonal.
Enjoy immediately or refrigerate until ready to eat.

title: Apple-Raisin Egg Rolls

ingredients.name: apple juice
ingredients.alternative: sweetened condensed milk mixed with water (1:4)

directions: In a large skillet, saute the apples, raisins and cinnamon in butter until tender. Combine the cornstarch, juice and honey until smooth; stir into apple mixture. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Cook and stir for 1-2 minutes or until thickened. Remove from the heat; cool.

Place 1/4 cupful of apple mixture in the center of one egg roll wrapper. Fold bottom corner over filling. Fold sides toward center over filling. Moisten remaining corner with water; roll up tightly to seal. Repeat with remaining apple mixture and wrappers. Let stand for 15 minutes.
In an electric skillet, heat 1 in. of oil to 375°. Fry turnovers, a few at a time, for 1-2 minutes on each side or until golden brown. Drain on paper towels. Serve with ice cream.

title: Milk French Toast (Egg-Free)
directions: Dissolve the sugar in the milk.
Cut the slices of bread into your preferred size and soak them in the mixture.
You can soak them for a while or lightly coat them, whichever you desire, but keep in mind that since no eggs are used, the bread will quickly soak up a lot of moisture.
Heat a frying pan with plenty of butter and toast the bread until golden brown.
Pour plenty of pancake syrup on one side, flip over, toast until a crust forms, and they are ready.
You can top your French toast with honey, granulated sugar or jam instead!
The same method works for these condiments as well.
Just toast them until the side with the topping added has a nice crust.
